extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: classic motor scooter, approx. 1.85 x 0.7 x 1.2 m (L x W x H), 10 in wheels
extras.notes: front faces -Y; stands upright on its center stand; wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); scooter_steering (handlebar with headlight and mirrors, steering column, front link, front fender) has its origin on the steering axis, tilted 22 deg: rotate around (0.000, 0.375, 0.927) in Blender Z-up coordinates = (0.000, 0.927, -0.375) in glTF Y-up, steering lock about +-30 deg (turn the front wheel about the same axis and pivot); no brand, no text, blank license plate

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
